people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.
translations.bsb: Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly from the north is coming against her.
translations.kjv: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
translations.asv: Egypt is a very fair heifer; but destruction out of the north is come, it is come.
